svg.aria-label: The ManyCords reader in its dark theme, showing a collection called Game Club with 7 new messages from two fictional servers. The sidebar lists the collections and the sources in this one and, at the bottom, a green capture status with a 24-hour coverage chart. The feed shows the newest messages first, each channel on its own coloured lane, with a thread branching off its parent channel and a dashed arc joining a reply to the message it answers.
